verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents creating a flag from the dashboard ('Go to the Features section… Click Create Feature') and toggling features on and off per environment without deploying new code, which covers the core of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows how fast a new user can sign up and get a flag live in production. missing for 10: documented quickstart or onboarding flow showing time from signup to a live production toggle, hands-on or independent corroboration of the 'within minutes' speed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a feature flag and toggle it live in production within minutes of signing up

citations.quote: Go to the **Features** section in your dashboard. Click **Create Feature**.
Enter a descriptive name for your flag (e.g., new_ui_enabled).
Easily toggle individual features on and off, and make changes without deploying new code
use Flagsmith to toggle that feature on or off for different environments, users or user segments.
